definitions.explanation: The area or environment around something or someone.

examples.english: There are many shops around the station.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{周|まわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけないで→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Don't bother the people around you.

notes:
{周|まわ}り refers to the area surrounding a person, place, or thing. One of the most common spatial words in everyday Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{周|まわ}り: around ~
- {周|まわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look around
- {周|まわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: people around (oneself)
- {周|まわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to be considerate of those around you

WRITING:
Also written as {回|まわ}り. Both are common, but {周|まわ}り is more standard for "surroundings."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧: surroundings (more formal/written)
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧: vicinity, neighborhood
- ⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧: nearby
